ambition: Discover a consequential recurring activity that MONTREAL.AI could make economically attainable with accessible intelligence and an invented missing mechanism. Propose a measurable software prototype for its real beneficiary outcome, then a different valuable capability that retained means might help construct. Prefer internal productive use; novelty, demand, full economics and value remain unestablished until tested.

engelbart.title: Augmenting Human Intellect: A Conceptual Framework

snapshot.body: we can begin developing powerful and economically feasible augmentation systems on the basis of what we now know and have.
Man-computer symbiosis is an expected development in cooperative interaction between men and electronic computers.
The world has arrived at an age of cheap complex devices of great reliability; and something is bound to come of it.

situational-awareness.title: From GPT-4 to AGI: Counting the OOMs

engelbart.statement: An improved arrangement of available tools may make useful intellectual work attainable before a stronger general machine arrives.

licklider.statement: Investigate complementary divisions of work between people and available computation; this historical forecast is not current evidence of autonomous performance.

bush.statement: Reliable inexpensive components may enable valuable complete arrangements; the outcome, missing mechanism and present economics remain to be discovered.

situational-awareness.statement: One published AI trajectory anticipates stronger models. Test alternative mechanisms and slower-progress futures instead of assuming its date or waiting for it.
